reports.title: Helen Kerr: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

concerns.quote: Cogent information about Ms [name redacted] declining mental health was provided repeatedly to Surrey and Borders Partnership secondary mental health teams from the refuge support workers. It was not explored with them, and insufficient weight was given to it during the triage process. Ms Kerr was not provided with appropriate and timely referrals for mental health treatment.
concerns.hazard: lack of timely mental health referrals

concerns.quote: The SCARF process does not enable information sharing between the Police, Mental Health Agencies and Surrey Adult Safeguarding out of hours. It is under review. It remains unclear how information sharing out of hours is to be achieved in a timely fashion to safeguard individuals and the public.
The refuge was not made aware of Ms [name redacted] presentation on the 31st March 2023 by Surrey Police. Her delusions about the actions of refuge workers could have put them in danger.
concerns.hazard: refuge staff unawareness of client's delusions
